theme: local file/state peer fold: STATE bit files → FOLDBITS → COMPARE/HARMONY → DECIDE plate

tests.name: positive_state_bits
tests.note: COMPARE before FLOW; FOLD_RESULT.txt written; EXIT 0

tests.name: soft_unity_floor
tests.cmd: all1 vs all0 bits; CUBALC_FOLD_MIN_UNITY=99 run -q -s
tests.note: EXPECT unity fail then PASS/CLEAR_ERR; unity_soft_fail=1; still exit 0

tests.name: foldbits_garbage_silent
tests.note: observed: non-01 input does not fatal; weak validation

weaknesses.title: IMPULSE/FLOW after FOLDBITS erases peer bit differences
weaknesses.detail: COMPARE immediately after FOLDBITS of 111… vs 000… yields hamming=10 unity≈84. After IMPULSE+FLOW 3 on the same cubes, COMPARE reports hamming=0 unity=100. Peer-fold agents that FLOW before COMPARE always see perfect unity. Cookbook peer_fold pulses before decide but does not warn that compare-after-flow is meaningless for loaded bits.
weaknesses.repro: FOLDBITS a "1111111111"; FOLDBITS b "0000000000"; COMPARE; IMPULSE; FLOW 3; COMPARE → second hamming 0

weaknesses.title: HARMONY overwrites UNITY from COMPARE
weaknesses.detail: After COMPARE, UNITY holds pairwise unity (e.g. 92). HARMONY then replaces UNITY with hive mean (e.g. 65). Agents that PRINT_JSON UNITY after both steps lose the pairwise value unless they LET unity_pct = UNITY immediately after COMPARE.
weaknesses.repro: COMPARE a b; LET u=UNITY; HARMONY; PRINT UNITY — not equal to u

weaknesses.title: FOLDBITS accepts non-01 garbage without hard fail
weaknesses.detail: FOLDBITS a "hello" leaves OK soft-zero-ish / n=0 but program continues; subsequent FOLDBITS with real bits still ok. No sticky last_err forced for alphabet violation. State workers cannot trust file content is a bit stream without host pre-validation.
weaknesses.repro: FOLDBITS a "hello"; FOLDBITS a "1010" — run ok:true

weaknesses.title: TYPEOF LAST after SYS ENV destroys value for SYS NUM
weaknesses.detail: SYS ENV sets LAST to the value; TYPEOF LAST probes kind but replaces LAST so SYS NUM no longer sees the env string. FOLD_MIN_UNITY override silently stayed 0 until TYPEOF LAST was removed. TYPEOF should not clobber LAST when probing LAST, or docs must say copy first.
weaknesses.repro: SYS ENV "CUBALC_FOLD_MIN_UNITY" OR ""; TYPEOF LAST; SYS NUM — fails to parse 99

weaknesses.title: No STATE-relative path form; must CAT state_dir + "/name"
weaknesses.detail: Every STATE plate still needs SYS STATE; SYS CAT state_dir "/peer0.bits". Agents reimplement path join; missing slash or double slash mistakes are easy. No SYS STATE FILE "peer0.bits".

weaknesses.title: UNITY printed as 0–100 integer while board log shows 0.0–1.0 float
weaknesses.detail: Board line unity=0.9219 vs var UNITY=92. Agents mixing cookbook float examples with PRINT_JSON integers mis-set FOLD_MIN_UNITY (99 vs 0.99).
weaknesses.repro: COMPARE then PRINT UNITY vs board log

workarounds: Always COMPARE/HARMONY immediately after FOLDBITS/SETDIGIT; FLOW only after snapshotting UNITY/HAMMING into LETs
LET unity_pct = UNITY right after COMPARE before HARMONY
Never TYPEOF LAST before SYS NUM on the same LAST value — TYPEOF the named var instead
Host-validate 01 alphabet before writing *.bits under STATE
SYS CAT state_dir "/file" for every plate path; mkdir -p CUBALC_STATE first
language_gaps: Document or fix FLOW clobbering FOLDBITS matrices before COMPARE
Separate vars: COMPARE_UNITY vs HARMONY_UNITY (stop overwriting UNITY)
FOLDBITS hard-fail or sticky err on non-01 input
TYPEOF that does not destroy LAST when target is LAST
SYS STATE FILE name → absolute path under CUBALC_STATE
Soft READ for optional bit files
